_comment: Watchlist for tooling-rot-siren.sh. Copy to rot-watch.json and edit.
Each entry may set any subset of the four keys; omitted keys skip that check.
plugin       plugin id as it appears in installed_plugins.json / enabledPlugins
cli          command name on PATH; its --version is compared to the plugin version
An EMPTY watch array is treated as a finding, not a pass — that is deliberate.
